newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Danzas says business stayed strong in April.
newsitem.headline: Danzas says business stayed strong in April.

text.p: Danzas Holding AG Chairman Peter Gross said group business remained strong in April and the company remained optimistic, but added 1997 result would depend to a large degree on development in Europe's economy.

Speaking at the annual news confernce, Gross said it was difficult to make a prognosis for 1997. "We do not generate primary business. We follow the producer business...The question is how well is the primary business doing," he said.
He said it was important to see how the economy progresses, especially in Europe, saying the strength of economic recovery remained an open question.
"But it appears in April that it (Danzas's business) was fairly good. A certain amount of optimism is present," he said.
Danzas chief executive Peter Wagner also emphasised that business depended on producers' output and said Danzas had costs under control.
